title: Supervisor de engenharia
description:
Somos uma empresa global, líder no desenvolvimento de infraestruturas regenerativas que geram um impacto positivo na sociedade. Nossa força de trabalho de mais de 60.000 profissionais em mais de 40 países nos cinco continentes contribui para a nossa missão de projetar um planeta melhor. Estamos à procura de pessoas que queiram fazer a diferença, promover o desenvolvimento sustentável e encontrar soluções para os grandes desafios globais, como a mudança climática, a superpopulação e a escassez de água. Junte-se a nós na busca de soluções para um futuro sustentável.


Na ACCIONA Construção, estamos à procura de um/a Supervisor de Engenharia Elétrica (H/M) para desempenhar a função em nosso projeto da L6 Laranja do Metrô de São Paulo, na área da Engenharia Elétrica.

Conheça Mais Sobre a Oportunidade


Descrição do trabalho

Supervisionar, revisar e validar a documentação técnica de engenharia elétrica (estudos, relatórios, diagramas, memoriais de cálculo, procedimentos, entre outros).

Avaliar tecnicamente soluções propostas por equipes de engenharia e fornecedores, apoiando a tomada de decisão técnica com foco em desempenho, confiabilidade e segurança.

Garantir a correta aplicação de normas técnicas, especificações contratuais e diretrizes do Metrô de São Paulo.

Atuar como referência técnica para as equipes de engenharia, obra, suprimentos e comissionamento.

Coordenar tecnicamente interfaces entre disciplinas (energia, sistemas ferroviários, civil, BIM, etc.) e stakeholders internos e externos.

Apoiar a identificação e gestão de riscos técnicos , propondo soluções e estratégias de mitigação.

Participar de reuniões técnicas, revisões de projeto, processos de aprovação e alinhamentos com o cliente.


Requisitos dos candidatos

Necessário Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica

Experiência comprovada em documentação de engenharia elétrica conforme o padrão do Metrô de São Paulo

Experiência sólida em engenharia elétrica aplicada a projetos de infraestrutura ferroviária, sistemas ferroviários e energia

Vivência consistente em processos de revisão, aprovação e gestão de documentação técnica

Capacidade analítica, senso crítico e habilidade para tomada de decisões técnicas .

Perfil de liderança técnica , com boa comunicação, postura colaborativa e orientação a resultados.

Domínio de normas técnicas aplicáveis e boas práticas de engenharia.

Disponibilidade para trabalhar na Zona Norte/SP

title: Consultor Salesforce - Marketing Cloud Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 59257


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei #fera em marketing cloud, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência em Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Habilidades com Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Email Studio, Automation Studio.
  • Desejável: conhecimento em Data Cloud, SQL para manipulação de dados dentro do automation e noções de governança e boas práticas dentro do SFMC.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira!


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Detalhes da oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor Fullstack altamente qualificado(a), com forte expertise em testes automatizados, desenvolvimento backend utilizando tecnologias modernas .NET e experiência prática com serviços em nuvem Azure.


Responsabilidades:

  • Construir toda a infraestrutura de testes do projeto
  • Escrever testes unitários, integração e E2E
  • Implementar e manter mocks (NSubstitute)
  • Gerar e analisar relatórios de cobertura
  • Configurar pipelines com GitHub Actions
  • Garantir que a suíte de testes permaneça estável, confiável e saudável


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida na construção e manutenção de infraestrutura de testes
  • Forte conhecimento em Testes Unitários, Testes de Integração e Testes Funcionais (E2E)
  • Proficiência com NSubstitute para criação de mocks
  • Capacidade de escrever, executar e depurar testes automatizados
  • Experiência na geração e comunicação de relatórios de cobertura de testes
  • Experiência no uso do GitHub como plataforma de controle de versão
  • Experiência prática na configuração e manutenção de GitHub Actions para execução automatizada de testes e workflows de CI
  • Capacidade comprovada de garantir a manutenibilidade e confiabilidade das suítes de testes
  • Forte experiência com C#
  • Proficiência em .NET 8 / .NET 9 / .NET 10
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs minimalistas (Minimal APIs)

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor Fullstack altamente qualificado(a), com forte expertise em testes automatizados, desenvolvimento backend utilizando tecnologias modernas .NET e experiência prática com serviços em nuvem Azure.

We are looking for retail domain experts (5+ years experience) to create real-world, profession-based prompts and tasks. The role involves creating high quality prompts and documents to evaluate model responses on day-to-day work in retail operations, sales, and customer-facing environments.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and either Golang, Node.js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. This engineer will contribute to the development of OrderAI, an AI-powered system that allows restaurants to take customer orders through voice interactions.

This role involves working on customer-focused products backed by LLM technologies, including real-time voice interfaces. The engineer will be able to contribute at any point in the full development cycle from the identification of system requirements and enhancements, coding the system to address these requirements, testing the system for quality control, releasing system changes, and documentation of system changes. title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
  • Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
  • Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
  • Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
  • Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
  • Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
  • Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
  • Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
  • Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.

  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.

Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.

  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python + React) — AI StartupSenior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Productivity Platform (Remote)
description:
Position: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI Platform)


About Us

We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.

Our platform powers advanced AI workflows such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, document intelligence, and structured data search — with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability in production environments.


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help design, build, and scale both the backend systems and frontend experiences of our AI platform. You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.

This role is ideal for engineers who think end-to-end: you care about clean API design and reliable backend architecture, but you're equally motivated by building polished, responsive interfaces that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive.


Responsibilities


Backend & Platform

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services in Python
  • Develop and evolve RESTful and WebSocket APIs supporting AI workflows and enterprise use cases
  • Build and maintain AI orchestration layers (RAG pipelines, agent systems, retrieval modules)
  • Integrate multiple data sources: vector databases, structured/tabular data, files, and web search
  • Own backend architecture decisions with a strong focus on performance, security, and reliability


Frontend & User Experience

  • Build and iterate on production React interfaces using Next.js and TypeScript
  • Translate complex AI capabilities into clean, usable UI patterns — from research dashboards to interactive data views
  • Implement real-time features such as streaming responses, live status indicators, and dynamic content updates
  • Ensure frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices


Cross-Cutting

  • Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end
  • Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and automated testing across the stack
  • Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
  • Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software
  • Strong proficiency in Python with experience building backend services (FastAPI or similar)
  • Strong proficiency in React with experience in Next.js and TypeScript
  • Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases
  • Comfort working across the full stack — you don't need to be told where the problem is
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI agent systems
  • Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search (e.g. OpenSearch)
  • Experience with real-time interfaces (WebSockets, streaming, SSE)
  • Background in enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with Vercel for frontend hosting and deployment
  • Knowledge of authentication systems (e.g. Clerk, Auth0)
  • Knowledge of security best practices and compliance (SOC 2 is a plus)
  • Experience working with high-scale or high-availability systems


What We Offer

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems used by enterprise customers
  • High-impact role with ownership across the full stack
  • Flexible remote work (Worldwide)
  • Direct collaboration with experienced engineers and founders
  • Fast-paced environment with real production challenges
  • Strong influence on technical and product decisions


Location Remote (Worldwide)

Hiring Model Contractor


How to Apply Please reply here with your CV or portfolio. If you enjoy building serious full-stack systems for real AI products — from the Python services that power intelligent workflows to the React interfaces that put them in users' hands — we'd love to hear from you.

title: Technical Support Manager – (IAM, Entra ID , Active Directory) - Salary: $4,500-$5,500 per month
description:
Salary: $4,500-$5,500 per month


A rapidly growing and well-established enterprise technology company operating in the identity and security space is expanding its leadership team. The business delivers advanced solutions that enable organizations to manage access, automate identity processes, and modernize authentication across complex environments.


They offer an excellent salary package , great benefits , and a genuinely supportive working environment . With a very strong, experienced team , low attrition , and clear career progression , this is a stable, long-term opportunity where many professionals have built lasting careers.

This is a hands-on leadership position suited to an experienced IAM professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while leading a high-performing team. You’ll take ownership of support operations, act as the senior technical escalation point, and play a key role in scaling and improving support capabilities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage the technical support function for an enterprise identity platform, ensuring reliability, security, and performance.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex IAM issues across authentication, provisioning, and federation workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and support hybrid identity environments spanning cloud, on-prem, and legacy systems.
  • Oversee support operations including ticket management, SLAs, escalations, and performance reporting
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to resolve issues efficiently and improve platform capability.
  • Drive automation initiatives, including AI-enabled support tools and self-service solutions.
  • Develop knowledge frameworks, documentation, and processes to improve efficiency and reduce resolution time.
  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing support engineering team, maintaining a strong hiring pipeline.


Required Skills:

  • 8+ years’ experience in Identity & Access Management, cybersecurity, or enterprise identity infrastructure.
  • Strong experience within enterprise SaaS environments and complex identity ecosystems.
  • Expertise in identity protocols such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SCIM.
  • Strong knwledge or experience in IAM, Entra ID & Active Directory
  • Hands-on experience with directory services, cloud identity platforms, and system integrations.
  • Proven leadership experience managing technical support teams in SaaS or security-focused organizations.
  • Strong background in incident management, escalations, SLAs, and customer performance metrics.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.


Nice to Have:

  • Degree in Computer Science, IT, or Cybersecurity.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, Security+, or IAM-related credentials).
  • Experience with leading identity platforms and automation tools.

description:

Nossa força de trabalho de mais de 60.000 profissionais em mais de 40 países nos cinco continentes contribui para a nossa missão de projetar um planeta melhor. Estamos à procura de pessoas que queiram fazer a diferença, promover o desenvolvimento sustentável e encontrar soluções para os grandes desafios globais, como a mudança climática, a superpopulação e a escassez de água. Supervisionar, revisar e validar a documentação técnica de engenharia elétrica (estudos, relatórios, diagramas, memoriais de cálculo, procedimentos, entre outros).

Avaliar tecnicamente soluções propostas por equipes de engenharia e fornecedores, apoiando a tomada de decisão técnica com foco em desempenho, confiabilidade e segurança.

Garantir a correta aplicação de normas técnicas, especificações contratuais e diretrizes do Metrô de São Paulo.

title: Vibecoder
description:
A Human é um ecossistema criado por criativos para criativos, que nasceu para explorar o encontro entre criatividade humana e inteligência artificial.


Nascemos da prática e estamos criando projetos reais, testando novas ferramentas e desenvolvendo novos fluxos de trabalho todos os dias dentro de empresas como Google, Nestlé e Stone.

  • Testar e implementar novas ferramentas (Lovable, Replit, Claude Code, GPT Codex, etc.);
  • Transformar IA em processo (não só em experimentação).


Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência construindo produtos (projetos próprios, freelas, startups ou dentro de empresas);
  • Familiaridade com vibe coding e ferramentas de AI-assisted coding;
  • Mentalidade prática: tirar ideias do papel rápido;
  • Boa comunicação para colaborar com times criativos;
  • Interesse real por criatividade, cultura e tecnologia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência criando automações ou agentes de IA;
  • Vivência com ferramentas como Cursor, v0, Bolt, Replit, entre outras;
  • Já ter atuado em projetos criativos ou campanhas;
  • Interesse em explorar novas formas de criação com IA.

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Video Editor – Part-Time, Remote
description:
Hours: 20 hours/week

Location: Remote


About Wildfleur

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transform UGC, influencer clips, and brand shoots into ads that feel authentic, on-trend, and true to our brand identity.
  • Edit raw footage into short, engaging TikTok and Instagram videos.
  • Use eye-catching edits: clean transitions, quick cuts, trending sounds, and storytelling hooks.
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and effects while keeping the skincare/beauty audience in mind.
  • Ensure videos are exported in the correct formats, resolutions, and aspect ratios for each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and paid ads).
  • Stay on top of TikTok & Instagram trends.
  • Keep video assets organized and workflows smooth for ongoing projects.


Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio of short-form content.
  • Proven track record of creating high-converting paid social media ads and working extensively with UGC.
  • Portfolio examples in beauty, skincare, or cosmetics content are preferred - you understand the audience and the aesthetics.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written, for seamless communication and creating platform-native captions.
  • Passionate about cosmetics/skincare culture - you enjoy this world and bring genuine interest into the content.
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
  • Comfortable working in CapCut or mobile-friendly apps when quick, social-native edits are needed.
  • Up-to-date with social media culture, trends, hooks, and viral formats.
  • Strong technical knowledge of video requirements for social media (aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, file sizes, export settings).
  • Highly detail-oriented, delivering content that is both on-trend and brand-consistent.
  • A degree in a creative field (film, media, communications, design) or background in filming/content creation is a plus (not required).


Perks

  • Flexible remote schedule.
  • Be part of a supportive and creative team

title: Senior Wordpress Developer (Subscription & Circulation Systems)
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate WordPress with subscription, paywall, and circulation systems .
  • Build and maintain API integrations between WordPress and external platforms.
  • Ensure reliable synchronization of user data, subscriptions, billing, and content access .
  • Design backend services and middleware to support multi-system communication .
  • Work closely with product and data teams to support subscription and audience workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data flows across systems for performance and reliability.
  • Develop scalable solutions for high-traffic media platforms .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of WordPress development experience with backend focus.
  • Strong experience with API integrations and distributed systems .
  • Experience with platforms such as Darwin CX and Naviga NCS Circ .
  • Experience with subscription/paywall systems and audience management platforms.
  • Proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and REST/webhooks.
  • Experience integrating WordPress with external SaaS platforms or enterprise systems .
  • Understanding of authentication, data synchronization, and system reliability.

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Wellbeing Support

title: Business Development Representative Mid
description:
Business Development Representative Mid


About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the Opportunity:


Avenue Code is expanding US Business Development team and looking for a highly proactive, organized, and fluent English speaker to join as a BDR. This person will be responsible for generating qualified leads and supporting the sales team with prospecting across different business lines, including AI, cloud, staffing, and internal products.


You'll work with modern tools and automations, including AI-powered content creation to assist in outreach. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow and have a direct impact on pipeline development.



Responsibilities:


Lead prospecting in the US market focused on setting qualified meetings.

Use tools like Apollo, LinkedIn, and pre-built cadences to reach out to prospects.

Make cold calls when necessary.

Keep interactions and activities updated in Salesforce.

Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across many business areas (AI, cloud, staffing, etc.).

Partner closely with Account Executives.



Requirements


Fluent English (spoken and written).

Previous experience as a BDR or SDR.

Highly organized and able to follow structured processes.

Comfortable using prospecting and automation tools (e.g., Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Proactive, results-driven, and motivated by performance.



Nice to Have:


Experience selling technology solutions (e.g., Google Cloud, AI, Salesforce).

Background in consulting or IT services companies.

Familiarity with Salesforce as a CRM.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company. They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering our flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure our software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Webix UI platform
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Certifications beneficial: AZ-204, AZ-900
  • Experience with DevOps Pipelines, YAML.
  • Experience using OpenAI or other AI API Platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor or similar).
  • Knowledge of monitoring/logging tools (App Insights, CloudWatch, DataDog).
  • Experience with performance profiling



This is a CLT Role at R$18,000/month

Procuramos um estudante ou recém-formado em Economia (ou áreas correlatas) que queira acelerar sua entrada no mercado de tecnologia através da Inteligência Artificial Operacional.

Você não será um programador focado em sintaxe tradicional, mas um Vibecoder: um profissional que utiliza o poder do Claude Code e agentes de IA para construir, gerenciar e escalar serviços de dados reais na nuvem.

title: Graphic Designer (Motion)
description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer (Motion) with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion.


You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentation and motion graphics.


This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation and smart use of AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.



What you’ll do

  • Design high-quality social media creative, digital graphics, presentations and branded visual systems across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Create motion graphics and animated elements - including transitions, text animations, graphics packages and lightweight video edits for short-form content.
  • Apply brand guidelines consistently while finding space for creativity and innovation.
  • Use AI and modern creative tools to speed up ideation, design variations, motion workflows and content exploration.
  • Collaborate with creative leads and project managers to clarify briefs, address feedback and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Maintain clean, organised files and a high standard of craft across motion and static work.



What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer, Motion Designer, or hybrid creative role.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing brand design, social content, motion graphics and layout expertise.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and strong working knowledge of Figma and presentation design tools.
  • Understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, colour systems and brand identity.
  • Ability to animate and design for modern platforms (Reels, TikTok, YouTube, paid social, etc).
  • Familiarity with AI or automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway and Midjourney).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and evolving briefs.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.



Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility - powered by smart tech, streamlined systems and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative and be part of a modern creative operation - we’d love to hear from you.



Benefits

  • USD-based compensation
  • Work from anywhere

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:


  • Atender às ocorrências operacionais relacionadas a ambientes da empresa, como vazamentos, falhas elétricas, problemas em vestiários, refeitório, banheiros, entre outros.
  • Acionar fornecedores de manutenção corretiva e acompanhar a execução dos serviços contratados.
  • Verificar no local a natureza do problema e registrar a ocorrência de forma adequada.
  • Conferir se os serviços foram realizados conforme combinado, observando prazos, qualidade e emissão da nota fiscal.
  • Utilizar o sistema de gestão de viagens corporativas para registrar, acompanhar e controlar solicitações, aprovações, reservas e prestação de contas.
  • Apoiar o controle das rotinas operacionais de Facilities, em interface com a equipe.
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento do transporte fretado, consumo no restaurante e funcionamento dos equipamentos e estruturas da unidade.
  • Manter registros atualizados em planilhas e relatórios simples de ocorrências e atendimentos realizados.
  • Apoiar o controle orçamentário da área, acompanhando os gastos mensais com serviços de Facilities e viagens, e comparando com o previsto.
  • Sinalizar ao Supervisor e a equipe, eventuais falhas ou desvios operacionais.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo, desejável cursando Ensino Superior em Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office, principalmente Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA.
  • Desejável conhecimento na execução de atividades operacionais relacionadas aos serviços de Facilities como: viagens, hospedagens, combustíveis, táxi, locações de veículos (Frota), apoio quanto a solicitação dos materiais de limpeza e fardamentos, cadastros de fornecedores internos;
  • Vivência com o sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

description:
Agente de Viagens Corporativas – Emissão Aérea Internacional (Sênior)


Grupo TravelCorp – Corporate Travel Solutions

Com a expansão da operação e aumento da demanda por viagens internacionais, buscamos profissionais experientes em emissão aérea internacional para reforçar nossa equipe em São Paulo.

  • Atendimento a clientes corporativos com alto nível de exigência
  • Cotação, reserva e emissão de bilhetes nacionais e internacionais
  • Montagem e cálculo de rotas complexas e multitrechos
  • Alterações, reemissões e gestão de regras tarifárias
  • Apoio na gestão de viagens corporativas conforme políticas de viagem
  • Atendimento por telefone, e-mail e sistemas corporativos

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em emissão aérea internacional
  • Experiência comprovada em viagens corporativas
  • Domínio de GDS Sabre
  • Experiência com regras tarifárias internacionais
  • Conhecimento em portais de companhias aéreas e consolidadoras
  • Vivência com remarcações, reemissões e cálculo de rotas
  • Organização, agilidade e raciocínio lógico


Importante:

Candidatos sem experiência em emissão internacional corporativa não serão considerados.



Diferenciais

  • Experiência com OBT
  • Experiência com STUR
  • Vivência em agências de corporate travel
  • Inglês intermediário

Presencial

Região da Liberdade – São Paulo


Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Salário competitivo

  • Plano de Saúde

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate WordPress with subscription, paywall, and circulation systems .
  • Build and maintain API integrations between WordPress and external platforms.
  • Ensure reliable synchronization of user data, subscriptions, billing, and content access .
  • Design backend services and middleware to support multi-system communication .
  • Work closely with product and data teams to support subscription and audience workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data flows across systems for performance and reliability.
  • Develop scalable solutions for high-traffic media platforms .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of WordPress development experience with backend focus.
  • Strong experience with API integrations and distributed systems .
  • Experience with platforms such as Darwin CX and Naviga NCS Circ .
  • Experience with subscription/paywall systems and audience management platforms.
  • Proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and REST/webhooks.
  • Experience integrating WordPress with external SaaS platforms or enterprise systems .
  • Understanding of authentication, data synchronization, and system reliability.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Administrator

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Duration: 6months

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Salesforce Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize our Salesforce platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring data integrity, automation efficiency, and user adoption.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce platform including user setup, profiles, roles, and permissions
  • Design and implement custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, and flows
  • Build and manage reports and dashboards for business insights
  • Automate business processes using Flow, Process Builder (legacy), and approval processes
  • Perform data management including imports, deduplication, and data quality monitoring
  • Support Sales, Service, and other cloud users with issue resolution and enhancements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and translate business requirements
  • Ensure system security, compliance, and best practices
  • Manage releases, change sets, and deployments
  • Provide user training and drive Salesforce adoption


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Salesforce configuration (Objects, Fields, Layouts)
  • Flow Builder (must-have)
  • Reports & Dashboards
  • Data Loader / Data Import Wizard
  • Understanding of Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud
  • Knowledge of security model (Profiles, Roles, Sharing Rules)
  • Experience with data quality and governance
  • Familiarity with integration concepts (REST/SOAP APIs – basic level)
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills


Primary Skills

1.Salesforce Platform hands-on experience

2.Salesforce admin expertise (Security Model, Data Model, End to End configuration, Flows etc)

3. Salesforce Admin Cert

4. Reports & Dashboards – Handson


Secondary Skills

1. Sales Cloud, Service Cloud

2. Business analysis

3. Stakeholder Management

title: [Dados] Engenharia de Dados Senior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Acreditamos que o SUCESSO do cliente é o nosso SUCESSO!

E para isso, estamos à procura de pessoas inquietas, fanáticas por resultados e amantes de tecnologia, para apoiar na implementação de Inteligência artificial nas soluções mobile e em nuvem para a área de Logística.

Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, trabalho em equipe e gosta de fazer acontecer esta vaga será sua!

Venha trabalhar em um ambiente que valoriza gente boa que é boa gente.

Venha ser um TOTVS!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar e preparar pipelines de dados para alimentar soluções de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Atuar no treinamento, avaliação e evolução de modelos de Machine Learning integrados aos produtos de Logística;
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade e governança dos dados, seguindo os padrões corporativos de qualidade;
  • Implementar melhorias contínuas em modelos já em produção para garantir a aderência ao negócio.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação superior completa ou cursando em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Prática em estruturação de dados, preparação de datasets e construção de pipelines;
  • Experiência com fluxos de Machine Learning (treinamento, validação e métricas de performance);
  • Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de Data Warehouse e Data Lake;
  • Noções de MLOps, incluindo versionamento de modelos e automação.


Diferenciais (O que te destaca)

  • Proficiência em Python e SQL (essenciais para a manipulação de dados na nossa stack);
  • Experiência com GCP (BigQuery) ;
  • Conhecimento em IA Generativa e implementação de LLMs;
  • Prática com streaming de dados e inferência em tempo real;
  • Experiência prévia em sistemas logísticos ou operacionais.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Business Development Representative Mid
description:
Business Development Representative Mid


About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the Opportunity:


Avenue Code is expanding US Business Development team and looking for a highly proactive, organized, and fluent English speaker to join as a BDR. This person will be responsible for generating qualified leads and supporting the sales team with prospecting across different business lines, including AI, cloud, staffing, and internal products.


You'll work with modern tools and automations, including AI-powered content creation to assist in outreach. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow and have a direct impact on pipeline development.



Responsibilities:


Lead prospecting in the US market focused on setting qualified meetings.

Use tools like Apollo, LinkedIn, and pre-built cadences to reach out to prospects.

Make cold calls when necessary.

Keep interactions and activities updated in Salesforce.

Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across many business areas (AI, cloud, staffing, etc.).

Partner closely with Account Executives.



Requirements


Fluent English (spoken and written).

Previous experience as a BDR or SDR.

Highly organized and able to follow structured processes.

Comfortable using prospecting and automation tools (e.g., Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Proactive, results-driven, and motivated by performance.



Nice to Have:


Experience selling technology solutions (e.g., Google Cloud, AI, Salesforce).

Background in consulting or IT services companies.

Familiarity with Salesforce as a CRM.

title: Emissor de Viagens Corporativas – Emissão Internacional (Sênior | Sabre)
description:
Agente de Viagens Corporativas – Emissão Aérea Internacional (Sênior)


Grupo TravelCorp – Corporate Travel Solutions


Desde 1994 , a TravelCorp Viagens e Turismo é reconhecida como uma das agências mais respeitadas do mercado de viagens corporativas no Brasil , atendendo empresas nacionais e multinacionais com alto padrão de eficiência, agilidade e personalização.


Com a expansão da operação e aumento da demanda por viagens internacionais, buscamos profissionais experientes em emissão aérea internacional para reforçar nossa equipe em São Paulo.


Esta posição é voltada a profissionais com vivência real em operações de corporate travel , domínio de GDS e rotas complexas , e capacidade de atuar com clientes exigentes e prazos curtos.



Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atendimento a clientes corporativos com alto nível de exigência
  • Cotação, reserva e emissão de bilhetes nacionais e internacionais
  • Montagem e cálculo de rotas complexas e multitrechos
  • Alterações, reemissões e gestão de regras tarifárias
  • Apoio na gestão de viagens corporativas conforme políticas de viagem
  • Atendimento por telefone, e-mail e sistemas corporativos

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em emissão aérea internacional
  • Experiência comprovada em viagens corporativas
  • Domínio de GDS Sabre
  • Experiência com regras tarifárias internacionais
  • Conhecimento em portais de companhias aéreas e consolidadoras
  • Vivência com remarcações, reemissões e cálculo de rotas
  • Organização, agilidade e raciocínio lógico


Importante:

Candidatos sem experiência em emissão internacional corporativa não serão considerados.



Diferenciais

  • Experiência com OBT
  • Experiência com STUR
  • Vivência em agências de corporate travel
  • Inglês intermediário

Local de Trabalho

Presencial

Região da Liberdade – São Paulo


Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Salário competitivo
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição
  • Plano de Saúde


Se você possui experiência sólida em emissão internacional corporativa e busca atuar em uma empresa consolidada no setor, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte da TravelCorp .
