title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Customer Support & Operations Specialist
description:
OysterLink is the fastest-growing restaurant & hospitality job site . The site recently launched and is generating over 350,000 monthly visitors organically.


We are seeking a forward-facing Customer Support & Operations Specialist with excellent English communication and organizational skills for:


  • Client & Applicant Communication
  • Platform Management & Issue Resolution
  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement


Required Skills:


  • Excellent English speaking skills and excellent grammar and communication skills
  • Attention to detail and ability to learn platform features
  • Strong customer service focus, ability to troubleshoot issues and come up with solutions
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively
  • Experience in ticket management & documenting feedback
  • Able to work between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. EST as we target a US demographic


The GOALS for this position is to:


  • Keep client response time during work hours under 1 hour, and issue resolution time under 2 hours
  • Ensure client feedback (bugs or improvements) is documented, logged, and plan resolutions for all client feedback (bugs or improvements) on the day it arrives


Responsibilities:


Client & Applicant Communication

  • Provide prompt support for inquiries, respond to questions, and offer guidance
  • Communicate effectively with companies and job seekers


Platform Management & Issue Resolution

  • Troubleshoot feature issues, monitor bug/support requests
  • Refresh and reorder featured job listings on our site and LinkedIn


Feedback & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and share client/applicant feedback with internal teams to enhance platform features


Prior to platform launch (on the current site)

  • Manage incoming “Post a Job” submissions
  • Gather missing information and confirm postings with clients
  • Collect and review CVs


The ideal candidate must be a proactive and independent thinker who can take ownership of the tasks at hand and ensure timely & quality output through collaboration with other team members.


Oyster Link offers competitive salaries, yearly growth opportunities AND profit sharing .


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position. We do require team members who can work up until 5 pm EST.


What we offer at OysterLink:

  • A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth
  • Job stability and growth
  • Profit Sharing
  • Shares in the company to receive an earn-out when the company is sold
  • Challenging projects and opportunity to work with great team members
  • Work-from-home opportunity
  • 4 weeks paid time off


We are seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Recruitment steps:

  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Receive a short questionnaire
  • Send back answers + CV
  • Receive Test
  • Have an interview with our Hiring Manager
  • Get feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: Analista de Produto Júnior (Vibecoder)
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Procuramos um estudante ou recém-formado em Economia (ou áreas correlatas) que queira acelerar sua entrada no mercado de tecnologia através da Inteligência Artificial Operacional.

Você não será um programador focado em sintaxe tradicional, mas um Vibecoder: um profissional que utiliza o poder do Claude Code e agentes de IA para construir, gerenciar e escalar serviços de dados reais na nuvem.

O que você vai fazer (The Vibe)

● Vibe Coding: Operar o Claude Code para conectar repositórios no GitHub, baixar skills e automatizar processos de dados com velocidade de IA.

● Gestão de Cloud: Supervisionar e configurar a infraestrutura no Google Cloud (Functions, Run, BigQuery) com o apoio das nossas ferramentas.

● Curadoria de UX: Sabemos que você não é designer e não esperamos que saiba usar ferramentas de desenho. Nós vamos te treinar para desenvolver um senso crítico apurado sobre hierarquia de informação. Seu papel será supervisionar e guiar as IAs para que o produto final seja útil, claro e eficiente para o usuário.

Perfil do Candidato

● Background Analítico (Economia/Exatas): Capacidade de entender a lógica de custos, incentivos e eficiência de processos.

● Mindset Pragmático: Foco em resolver o problema do cliente da forma mais inteligente e automatizada possível.

● Curiosidade Tecnológica: Vontade de dominar o ecossistema Google Cloud e ferramentas de \"coding-by-chat\".

● Vontade de Aprender: Disposição para passar pelo nosso treinamento proprietário de UX e Cloud.

O que oferecemos

● Treinamento de Elite: Acesso ao nosso Gem de IA, um tutor exclusivo que te guiará passo a passo em Cloud, Vibe Coding e Design Crítico.

● Cultura AI-First: Ambiente onde a produtividade via IA é a regra, não a exceção.

● Autonomia Real: Espaço para gerenciar produtos de dados e influenciar decisões de arquitetura e interface.



Benefícios:

Assistência Médica e odontológica · Seguro de Vida · Vale Alimentação/Refeição · Gympass ️ · 3 Days Off por ano

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Sobre a empresa:

  • Empresa multinacional do setor Financeiro até Logística para marcas de consumo nos EUA e na UE.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Supervisionar a alocação de estoque para pedidos B2B de múltiplas marcas que operam nos EUA e na Europa
  • Projetar a disponibilidade de estoque e fornecer visibilidade dos prazos futuros de entrega com base nos recebimentos de estoque
  • Recomendar ajustes ou extensões nos prazos das janelas de entrega para pedidos ou grupos de produtos, conforme a disponibilidade de estoque
  • Coordenar com o financeiro para garantir que os pedidos sejam liberados para cobrança antes dos embarques
  • Liberar pedidos para os armazéns com base nas janelas de entrega e garantir que as priorizações estejam alinhadas às necessidades do negócio
  • Colaborar com o especialista de logística outbound para acompanhar as prioridades diárias e o progresso junto aos 3PLs
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato para as equipes de vendas dos clientes, fornecendo atualizações de status, ajustes e feedback sobre os pedidos


O que você precisa ter:

  • Fluente em inglês, tanto falado quanto escrito
  • Pessoa proativa, orientada a soluções e focada em escalabilidade
  • Experiência em alocação de pedidos, customer success ou gestão da cadeia de suprimentos
  • Tem vontade de aprender a dinâmica de gerenciar múltiplos clientes e varejistas em diferentes países
  • Possui fortes habilidades organizacionais, de comunicação e de resolução de problemas, com grande atenção aos detalhes
  • Tem familiaridade com operações de 3PL, sistemas de gestão de pedidos ou ferramentas de planejamento de inventário (diferencial)
  • Sabe gerenciar prioridades e se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança


Observações:

  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Tipo de contrato: PJ

title: Graphic Designer (Motion)
description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer (Motion) with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion.


You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentation and motion graphics.


This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation and smart use of AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.



What you’ll do

  • Design high-quality social media creative, digital graphics, presentations and branded visual systems across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Create motion graphics and animated elements - including transitions, text animations, graphics packages and lightweight video edits for short-form content.
  • Apply brand guidelines consistently while finding space for creativity and innovation.
  • Use AI and modern creative tools to speed up ideation, design variations, motion workflows and content exploration.
  • Collaborate with creative leads and project managers to clarify briefs, address feedback and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Maintain clean, organised files and a high standard of craft across motion and static work.



What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer, Motion Designer, or hybrid creative role.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing brand design, social content, motion graphics and layout expertise.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and strong working knowledge of Figma and presentation design tools.
  • Understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, colour systems and brand identity.
  • Ability to animate and design for modern platforms (Reels, TikTok, YouTube, paid social, etc).
  • Familiarity with AI or automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway and Midjourney).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and evolving briefs.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.



Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility - powered by smart tech, streamlined systems and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative and be part of a modern creative operation - we’d love to hear from you.



Benefits

  • USD-based compensation
  • Work from anywhere

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company. They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering our flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure our software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Webix UI platform
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Certifications beneficial: AZ-204, AZ-900
  • Experience with DevOps Pipelines, YAML.
  • Experience using OpenAI or other AI API Platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor or similar).
  • Knowledge of monitoring/logging tools (App Insights, CloudWatch, DataDog).
  • Experience with performance profiling



This is a CLT Role at R$18,000/month

Grupo TravelCorp – Corporate Travel Solutions

  • Inglês intermediário

Presencial

Região da Liberdade – São Paulo

  • Vale Transporte

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Administrator

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Duration: 6months

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Salesforce Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize our Salesforce platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring data integrity, automation efficiency, and user adoption.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce platform including user setup, profiles, roles, and permissions
  • Design and implement custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, and flows
  • Build and manage reports and dashboards for business insights
  • Automate business processes using Flow, Process Builder (legacy), and approval processes
  • Perform data management including imports, deduplication, and data quality monitoring
  • Support Sales, Service, and other cloud users with issue resolution and enhancements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and translate business requirements
  • Ensure system security, compliance, and best practices
  • Manage releases, change sets, and deployments
  • Provide user training and drive Salesforce adoption


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Salesforce configuration (Objects, Fields, Layouts)
  • Flow Builder (must-have)
  • Reports & Dashboards
  • Data Loader / Data Import Wizard
  • Understanding of Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud
  • Knowledge of security model (Profiles, Roles, Sharing Rules)
  • Experience with data quality and governance
  • Familiarity with integration concepts (REST/SOAP APIs – basic level)
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills


Primary Skills

1.Salesforce Platform hands-on experience

2.Salesforce admin expertise (Security Model, Data Model, End to End configuration, Flows etc)

3. Salesforce Admin Cert

4. Reports & Dashboards – Handson


Secondary Skills

1. Sales Cloud, Service Cloud

2. Business analysis

3. Stakeholder Management

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company. They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering our flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure our software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Webix UI platform
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Certifications beneficial: AZ-204, AZ-900
  • Experience with DevOps Pipelines, YAML.
  • Experience using OpenAI or other AI API Platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor or similar).

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence

  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.

This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Customer Support & Operations Specialist
description:
OysterLink is the fastest-growing restaurant & hospitality job site . The site recently launched and is generating over 350,000 monthly visitors organically.


We are seeking a forward-facing Customer Support & Operations Specialist with excellent English communication and organizational skills for:


  • Client & Applicant Communication
  • Platform Management & Issue Resolution
  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement


Required Skills:


  • Excellent English speaking skills and excellent grammar and communication skills
  • Attention to detail and ability to learn platform features
  • Strong customer service focus, ability to troubleshoot issues and come up with solutions
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively
  • Experience in ticket management & documenting feedback
  • Able to work between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. EST as we target a US demographic


The GOALS for this position is to:


  • Keep client response time during work hours under 1 hour, and issue resolution time under 2 hours
  • Ensure client feedback (bugs or improvements) is documented, logged, and plan resolutions for all client feedback (bugs or improvements) on the day it arrives


Responsibilities:


Client & Applicant Communication

  • Provide prompt support for inquiries, respond to questions, and offer guidance
  • Communicate effectively with companies and job seekers


Platform Management & Issue Resolution

  • Troubleshoot feature issues, monitor bug/support requests
  • Refresh and reorder featured job listings on our site and LinkedIn


Feedback & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and share client/applicant feedback with internal teams to enhance platform features


Prior to platform launch (on the current site)

  • Manage incoming “Post a Job” submissions
  • Gather missing information and confirm postings with clients
  • Collect and review CVs


The ideal candidate must be a proactive and independent thinker who can take ownership of the tasks at hand and ensure timely & quality output through collaboration with other team members.


Oyster Link offers competitive salaries, yearly growth opportunities AND profit sharing .


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position. We do require team members who can work up until 5 pm EST.


What we offer at OysterLink:

  • A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth
  • Job stability and growth
  • Profit Sharing
  • Shares in the company to receive an earn-out when the company is sold
  • Challenging projects and opportunity to work with great team members
  • Work-from-home opportunity
  • 4 weeks paid time off


We are seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Recruitment steps:

  • Receive a short questionnaire
  • Send back answers + CV
  • Receive Test

A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados.

description:
.NET/C# - React (Fullstack)

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. You will play a fundamental part in delivering a robust and scalable user experience, working in a supportive, team-oriented environment alongside other engineers and product stakeholders to bring new capabilities to life.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, ensuring code is clean, performant, and adheres to high-quality standards;
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary teams—including Product, QA, and UX—in agile settings to deliver resilient solutions that support strategic business objectives;
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and propose architectural improvements to optimize platform performance and reliability;
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, promoting best development practices and contributing to team growth.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with the .NET/C# ecosystem for backend development and React for frontend in cloud-based (SaaS) environments;
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with AWS cloud platform (preferred), microservices architecture, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Deep knowledge of SQL and database design for both relational and non-relational systems (Postgres, MongoDB);
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and DevOps practices;
  • Knowledge or hands-on experience with the Angular framework for frontend development;
  • Experience with IDM (Identity Management).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Consultor SAP BRIM
description:
Consultor SAP BRIM – Convergent Charging

Início: imediato.

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado.

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto.

Horário de trabalho: 9h00 às 18h00.

Idioma: Inglês avançado.


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um Consultor SAP BRIM Sênior com forte experiência em SAP Convergent Charging (CC) para atuação em projetos e sustentação de soluções de billing e charging em ambientes de alta volumetria. O profissional será responsável pela modelagem, configuração e operação de cenários complexos de tarifação em tempo real e batch, integrando os componentes do SAP BRIM, como SOM, CI, FI-CA, e sistemas externos, como mediation, billing e CRM.


A posição envolve participação em implementações end-to-end, melhorias evolutivas e AMS, com forte atuação em desenho de solução, troubleshooting avançado, análise de performance e suporte à arquitetura BRIM.


Principais responsabilidades:


• Desenho e configuração de modelos de charging no SAP Convergent Charging.

• Criação e manutenção de Charge Plans, Charging Contexts, Price Plans e Charging Trees.

• Implementação de cenários de rating em tempo real (online charging) e batch (offline charging).

• Integração do SAP CC com SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI), SAP SOM e sistemas externos.

• Integração via Web Services, APIs e mediation systems.

• Troubleshooting de problemas de rating, inconsistências de consumo e performance de charging.

• Análise de logs e tuning de performance.

• Suporte a testes unitários, integrados e UAT.

• Participação na definição de arquitetura BRIM.

• Suporte em atividades de cutover e hypercare.

• Atuação tanto em projetos de implementação quanto em AMS/sustentação.


Requisitos Técnicos


• 6 a 8+ anos de experiência em SAP

• Pelo menos 3+ anos de experiência em SAP BRIM / Convergent Charging

• Experiência em pelo menos uma implementação end-to-end de BRIM.

• Conhecimento sólido de SAP BRIM (arquitetura end-to-end);

• Experiência avançada em SAP Convergent Charging (CC);

• Experiência com modelagem de pricing e rating.

• Experiência com integração entre SAP CC, SOM, CI, FI-CA e sistemas externos.

• Conhecimento de billing para telecom ou utilities.

• Experiência com Web Services, APIs e arquitetura distribuída.

• Experiência com análise de dados de alta volumetria e performance tuning.

• Forte experiência em troubleshooting e análise de logs.


Diferenciais


• Experiência com SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management);

• Conhecimento em SAP CI e FI-CA.

• Experiência com cenários pré-pagos e pós-pagos.

• Experiência em ambientes de grande escala (telecom ou utilities).


Competências Comportamentais


• Perfil analítico e orientado à solução.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

• Proatividade e autonomia;

• Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão;

• Organização e visão sistêmica


Perfil Profissional Esperado


Profissional sênior, com capacidade de atuar de forma independente em ambientes BRIM complexos, contribuindo com desenho de solução, sustentação de ambientes de alta volumetria e atuando como referência técnica em SAP Convergent Charging dentro do projeto ou operação.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

title: Head of Artificial Intelligence
description:
A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil.

Estamos construindo a próxima geração de software financeiro — com forte uso de IA aplicada a problemas reais, complexos e críticos.

Buscamos alguém para liderar essa evolução do ponto de vista técnico.


  • O desafio

Você será responsável por desenhar e liderar a construção de sistemas de decisão baseados em IA aplicados ao contexto financeiro.

Isso inclui desde interpretação de dados não estruturados até automação de fluxos críticos com alto nível de confiabilidade.


Essa não é uma vaga para trabalhar com IA. É uma vaga para construir sistemas que tomam decisões reais em produção.


  • Responsabilidades
  • Definir a arquitetura de sistemas baseados em IA (LLMs + lógica determinística)
  • Construir pipelines de processamento de dados (estruturados e não estruturados)
  • Desenvolver mecanismos de decisão automatizada com controle de risco
  • Projetar sistemas robustos, com:
  • fallback
  • validação
  • auditabilidade
  • Trabalhar próximo do time de engenharia para garantir escalabilidade e performance
  • Definir métricas e melhorar continuamente:
  • precisão
  • custo
  • confiabilidade


  • O que buscamos
  • Experiência real colocando sistemas de IA em produção (não apenas protótipos)
  • Forte capacidade de system design
  • Experiência com:
  • LLMs e/ou modelos de NLP
  • pipelines de dados
  • sistemas backend (APIs, filas, processamento assíncrono)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões pragmáticas (quando usar AI vs quando não usar)
  • Mentalidade de produto (impacto > perfeição)


  • Diferenciais
  • Experiência com dados financeiros ou sistemas críticos
  • Já construiu sistemas com alto requisito de confiabilidade
  • Experiência com avaliação e melhoria contínua de modelos
  • Consegue explicar trade-offs técnicos de forma clara


  • O que não buscamos
  • Perfis focados apenas em prompt engineering
  • Experiência apenas acadêmica ou experimental
  • Falta de experiência com sistemas em produção


  • Remuneração
  • Contrato PJ
  • Faixa: R$ 35k – R$ 45k/mês


  • Processo
  • Conversa inicial
  • Entrevista técnica
  • Case prático

title: Representante técnico de vendas
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados.

Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.


Atividades:


●Gestão de Relacionamento: Realizar o planejamento estratégico de visitas via CRM, garantindo a execução rigorosa das rotas e o cumprimento das metas de atendimento.

●Expansão de Mercado: Gerir e prospectar carteiras de clientes de forma ativa, identificando novas oportunidades de negócio na região.

●Suporte Técnico e Capacitação: Ministrar treinamentos técnicos e prestar assistência especializada tanto para canais de distribuição quanto para o cliente final.

●Desenvolvimento de Campo: Identificar, preparar e conduzir áreas de teste/demonstração após a formalização das negociações.

●Geração de Demanda: Apresentar resultados de performance através da instalação de campos demonstrativos (lado a lado/demoplots), consolidando a autoridade técnica da marca.


Requisitos e qualificações:


●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia.

●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região.

●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal.

●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

title: Sourcer LATAM
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Pleno para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação LATAM da AI/R Company, empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL fazem parte. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.



Você será responsável por:


  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.



O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Desejável vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Desejável Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Consultor SAP BRIM
description:
Consultor SAP BRIM – Convergent Charging

Início: imediato.

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado.

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto.

Horário de trabalho: 9h00 às 18h00.

Idioma: Inglês avançado.


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um Consultor SAP BRIM Sênior com forte experiência em SAP Convergent Charging (CC) para atuação em projetos e sustentação de soluções de billing e charging em ambientes de alta volumetria. O profissional será responsável pela modelagem, configuração e operação de cenários complexos de tarifação em tempo real e batch, integrando os componentes do SAP BRIM, como SOM, CI, FI-CA, e sistemas externos, como mediation, billing e CRM.


A posição envolve participação em implementações end-to-end, melhorias evolutivas e AMS, com forte atuação em desenho de solução, troubleshooting avançado, análise de performance e suporte à arquitetura BRIM.


Principais responsabilidades:


• Desenho e configuração de modelos de charging no SAP Convergent Charging.

• Criação e manutenção de Charge Plans, Charging Contexts, Price Plans e Charging Trees.

• Implementação de cenários de rating em tempo real (online charging) e batch (offline charging).

• Integração do SAP CC com SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI), SAP SOM e sistemas externos.

• Integração via Web Services, APIs e mediation systems.

• Troubleshooting de problemas de rating, inconsistências de consumo e performance de charging.

• Análise de logs e tuning de performance.

• Suporte a testes unitários, integrados e UAT.

• Participação na definição de arquitetura BRIM.

• Suporte em atividades de cutover e hypercare.

• Atuação tanto em projetos de implementação quanto em AMS/sustentação.


Requisitos Técnicos


• 6 a 8+ anos de experiência em SAP

• Pelo menos 3+ anos de experiência em SAP BRIM / Convergent Charging

• Experiência em pelo menos uma implementação end-to-end de BRIM.

• Conhecimento sólido de SAP BRIM (arquitetura end-to-end);

• Experiência avançada em SAP Convergent Charging (CC);

• Experiência com modelagem de pricing e rating.

• Experiência com integração entre SAP CC, SOM, CI, FI-CA e sistemas externos.

• Conhecimento de billing para telecom ou utilities.

• Experiência com Web Services, APIs e arquitetura distribuída.

• Experiência com análise de dados de alta volumetria e performance tuning.

• Forte experiência em troubleshooting e análise de logs.


Diferenciais


• Experiência com SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management);

• Conhecimento em SAP CI e FI-CA.

• Experiência com cenários pré-pagos e pós-pagos.

• Experiência em ambientes de grande escala (telecom ou utilities).


Competências Comportamentais


• Perfil analítico e orientado à solução.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

• Proatividade e autonomia;

• Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão;

• Organização e visão sistêmica


Perfil Profissional Esperado


Profissional sênior, com capacidade de atuar de forma independente em ambientes BRIM complexos, contribuindo com desenho de solução, sustentação de ambientes de alta volumetria e atuando como referência técnica em SAP Convergent Charging dentro do projeto ou operação.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

Operations Support | AI-First | Remote (LATAM)

Salary - USD $18,000 – $21,000/year  DOE + Monthly Health Insurance Bonus (~$100/mo)

Schedule - Monday–Friday, 8:30AM–5:30 PM EST

PTO - 10 days/year (accrual) | U.S. Holidays Off

Payments - Bi-weekly

Location - Remote — Latin America


This isn’t an assistant role where you wait to be told what to do.

This is a role where you own the details, drive the follow-through, and hold leadership accountable—even when it’s uncomfortable. If you need permission to take initiative, this isn’t the right fit. If you’re the person who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen, keep reading.


About Carbon Residential

Carbon Residential is a fast-growing, U.S.-based real estate investment firm managing a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties across multiple states. We operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging automation, data intelligence, and modern technology to drive operational excellence, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Efficiency isn’t optional here. It’s embedded in how we work.


We’re building something different. A company where people take ownership, where systems replace chaos, and where the right person in the right seat can have an outsized impact. That’s what this role is.


About the Role

You’ll serve as the right hand to the Director of Operations—providing direct administrative, operational, and financial support while acting as the accountability engine that keeps everything moving forward. This is not a “take notes and schedule meetings” role. This is a role where you own systems, chase down loose ends, flag what’s falling through the cracks, and push back when things aren’t getting done—including pushing back on the person you report to.


The Director will be the first to tell you: he’s a big-picture operator, not a details person. He needs someone who fills that gap—someone who tracks every commitment, follows up relentlessly, and isn’t afraid to say “Hey, this still isn’t done and it needs to be.” If that sounds like you, this role will give you more autonomy, exposure, and impact than most EA positions ever will.


You should be highly organized, financially literate, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools daily to multiply your output and improve workflows across the organization.


What Makes You Different

We’ve titled this section intentionally. We’re not looking for a generic set of skills—we’re looking for a specific type of person. The right hire has these qualities baked into who they are:


  • You’re a Self-Starter. You don’t wait for a task list. You look around, see what needs to happen, and do it. When you run out of assignments, you go find the next problem to solve. Downtime is your enemy.
  • You Take Initiative. You don’t ask “Should I do this?”—you do it and report back. You bring solutions, not questions. You anticipate needs before they’re communicated.
  • You Have Relentless Follow-Through. Nothing falls off your radar. If something was promised by Tuesday, you’re checking on it Monday. If a vendor said they’d send an invoice, you’re following up. You close every loop, every time.
  • You Hold People Accountable. This is the big one. You’re not afraid to hold your own boss accountable. If he said he’d review something and hasn’t, you follow up. If a deadline is slipping, you flag it. You do this professionally, respectfully, and firmly. You understand that accountability isn’t confrontation—it’s how things actually get done.
  • You’re Tough When It Matters. You know when to nudge and when to push. You don’t let things slide because it’s easier. You care enough about the outcome to have the uncomfortable conversation. You’re the person who makes the people around you better by refusing to let standards slip.
  • You’re Committed to Your Own Growth. You’re not just looking for a job—you’re looking for a trajectory. You invest in yourself personally and professionally, and you want to work somewhere that does the same. At Carbon, as the company grows, you grow with it. The Director genuinely cares about developing his people and believes that when you win, the whole team wins.


A note on availability and boundaries.

This role requires a willingness to be responsive to after-hours communications when they come up. Things move fast in real estate and sometimes decisions can’t wait until morning. That said, the Director respects boundaries and prioritizes work-life balance. You won’t be expected to be on-call 24/7—but when something urgent comes through, we need someone who’s willing to engage. It’s a two-way street built on mutual respect.


Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Follow-Through

  • Own the Director’s task list, commitments, and deadlines—track every open item and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding deliverables across departments, vendors, and leadership
  • Send reminders, escalate delays, and push back professionally when timelines are slipping
  • Maintain a running accountability tracker—who owes what, by when, and what’s overdue
  • Serve as the “closing engine” that turns conversations and commitments into completed tasks

AI-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

  • Use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, workflow automations) to draft communications, summarize reports, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain AI-assisted trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems
  • Continuously improve operational processes using AI-enhanced workflows

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Manage the Director’s calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Track ongoing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables using digital project management systems
  • Maintain organized, searchable digital filing systems
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items, and ensure follow-up execution

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, expense summaries, and budget trackers
  • Review invoices, receipts, and statements for accuracy before approval
  • Support monthly reporting cycles with clear, data-backed updates
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze financial data and flag discrepancies or trends

Property-Level Coordination & Communication

  • Support property-level day-to-day operations as directed
  • Contact vendors for invoices, and service updates—and follow up until closed


Our Core Values

At Carbon, our core values aren’t aspirational posters on a wall. They’re how we operate daily. The right person for this role lives these naturally:


  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You’re constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday’s process is tomorrow’s improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you’re in, you’re fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack,, and similar collaboration tools
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, AI writing assistants, workflow automation platforms)
  • Ability to create structured prompts that generate accurate, actionable outputs
  • Strong digital organization and documentation practices

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, or similar)
  • Understanding of real estate operations and multi-property support
  • Experience building dashboards, SOPs, or process documentation systems


Who Thrives in This Role


You thrive here if you’re the person who:

•  Sees a problem and fixes it before anyone asks

•  Constantly asks: “How can this be automated or improved?”

•  Has been told “You’re more organized than my actual manager”

•  Isn’t intimidated by holding senior leadership accountable

•  Treats AI as a core professional skill, not a novelty

•  Takes pride in being the person who never drops the ball


What’s in It for You

  • A forward-thinking, AI-enabled work environment where your tech skills are valued and encouraged
  • Direct exposure to U.S. leadership and real estate investment operations—not a middleman, not a body shop
  • A stable, long-term remote opportunity with consistent hours and bi-weekly pay
  • Health insurance bonus (~$100/month) to support your coverage
  • 10 days PTO annually plus U.S. holidays off
  • Real autonomy and real impact—your work directly shapes how the company operates
  • Work directly for a leader who genuinely wants to see his people grow and will invest in your development


One last thing.

If you read this job description and thought “That’s me”—we want to hear from you. We’d rather hire someone with the right DNA and train the technical gaps than hire a perfect resume with no backbone. Show us who you are.

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

Buscamos um Consultor SAP BRIM Sênior com forte experiência em SAP Convergent Charging (CC) para atuação em projetos e sustentação de soluções de billing e charging em ambientes de alta volumetria. • Atuação tanto em projetos de implementação quanto em AMS/sustentação.

• 6 a 8+ anos de experiência em SAP

• Pelo menos 3+ anos de experiência em SAP BRIM / Convergent Charging

• Experiência em pelo menos uma implementação end-to-end de BRIM.

• Conhecimento sólido de SAP BRIM (arquitetura end-to-end);

• Experiência avançada em SAP Convergent Charging (CC);

• Experiência com modelagem de pricing e rating.

• Conhecimento de billing para telecom ou utilities.

• Experiência com Web Services, APIs e arquitetura distribuída.

• Experiência com análise de dados de alta volumetria e performance tuning.

• Forte experiência em troubleshooting e análise de logs.


Diferenciais


• Experiência com SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management);

• Conhecimento em SAP CI e FI-CA.

• Experiência com cenários pré-pagos e pós-pagos.

• Experiência em ambientes de grande escala (telecom ou utilities).


Competências Comportamentais


• Perfil analítico e orientado à solução.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

• Proatividade e autonomia;

• Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão;

Profissional sênior, com capacidade de atuar de forma independente em ambientes BRIM complexos, contribuindo com desenho de solução, sustentação de ambientes de alta volumetria e atuando como referência técnica em SAP Convergent Charging dentro do projeto ou operação.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.

title: Senior Back-end Architect (Python)
description:
I’m helping Staffinit find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of Senior Back-end Architect (Python) .


You'll architect high-performance AI evaluation systems, directly impacting customer experience at scale.


Compensation:

USD 46.2 - 59.8/hour.


Location:

Remote (specific timezones).


Mission of Staffinit:

\"Our mission: to connect talent. empower businesses. We work with clients across industries, helping them build teams that make a difference, and support professionals in finding roles where they can thrive. At our core, we combine deep recruitment expertise with a human-centred approach—ensuring that each placement aligns skills, culture and ambition.

\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You are proficient in REST API, Query optimization, Event-driven architecture (EDA), Data modeling.
  • You have +3 years experience in Python, Asynchronous programming.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python) at the Architect / Team Leader / Principal Engineer level to collaborate with our Customer.


Project:

- The project is being carried out for a German client and involves building an evaluation platform — a key system enabling the testing of AI agents through simulated scenarios and monitoring of performance results.


Role in the Project:

- The Senior Python Backend Engineer will collaborate with an internal development team and technical leads.

- The role includes full ownership of building and developing solutions and deploying them to production environments.

- Microservices must be high-performance, low-latency, scalable, and reliable.


Candidate Expectations:

- A combination of deep Python knowledge with system design skills, architectural thinking, independence, and proactivity.

- Strong sense of ownership.

- Strong communication skills.

- Independence in designing and evolving system architecture.

- These solutions directly impact the quality of experience for customers testing and deploying AI agents at scale.


Collaboration Model:

- Contract through end of 2026 with a high likelihood of extension.

- Remote work (100% FTE).

- Project team of 4–5 people based in Poland.

- Occasional visits to the Berlin office possible.


Team Office Meetings:

- The client organizes so-called in-office weeks — typically 3–5 days in the office, approximately twice per quarter.

- We try to schedule these flexibly around the team.

- Part of the team works from the UK and also joins these meetings.

- Attendance is not mandatory but is appreciated for collaboration and team building.


Requirements:

Python and Backend:

- Strong knowledge of modern Python, at least 3 years of experience with versions 3.10 and above (asyncio, concurrency, asynchronous programming).

- Experience building backend services running in production environments, 7+ years expected.


System Design and Maintenance:

- Designing and implementing REST APIs.

- Designing scalable distributed systems.

- Experience with event-driven architecture or task queue-based systems.

- Designing fault-tolerant and overload-resistant systems.

- Experience maintaining production systems.


Data Processing and Persistence:

- Production experience with databases (NoSQL, MongoDB preferred).

- Data modeling, schema management, migrations.

- Query and database structure optimization.


Concurrency and Task Processing:

- Background task processing architecture.

- Handling long-running and parallel tasks.

- Worker models and process isolation.


Engineering Ownership and Communication:

- End-to-end ownership of delivered solutions — from analyzing and verifying requirements, designing architecture, through to production deployment.

- Ability to make technical decisions, analyze and address risks.

- Good English communication skills.


Nice to Have:

Python Ecosystem:

- FastAPI or other async web frameworks.

- Pydantic and type-based validation.

- Static type checking (mypy).


Distributed and Event-Driven Systems:

- Kafka or similar streaming systems.

- Task queuing and load distribution systems.

- Multi-tenant system design.


Cloud and Containerization:

- Kubernetes and container deployments.

- CI/CD and deployment automation.


System Observability:

- Distributed tracing systems (e.g. OpenTelemetry).

- Metrics-based monitoring and SLOs.


Performance and Scaling:

- High-throughput systems.

- Load balancing and queue sharding.


AI / LLM Integrations:

- Integration with language model APIs.

- Designing evaluation and scoring pipelines.

- Managing rate limits and model query costs.


Work Environment and Tooling:

Backend and Infrastructure:

- FastAPI, Uvicorn,

- MongoDB (Motor).

- Redis (task queues).

- Kafka / Azure Event Hubs.

- Kong as middleware layer for LLM integrations.


Observability and Monitoring:

- OpenTelemetry.

- Datadog.

- Structured logging and trace correlation.


Delivery and Infrastructure:

- Kubernetes and Helm.

- Docker (multi-stage builds).

- GitHub Actions (CI/CD).

- ArgoCD (GitOps).


Python Tooling:

- UV (dependency management).

- Ruff, mypy.

- Pytest, testcontainers.


AI Integrations:

- OpenAI SDK and structured model responses.

- LLM Gateway architecture.

- Token usage and rate limit control.

title: Partner Analyst – Global Cloud & SAP Ecosystems
description:
Partner Analyst – Global Cloud & SAP Ecosystems

Contract - 12 Months

LATM Based - Remote Work


The Partner Analyst supports the development, governance, and optimisation of global partner programs across SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud . The role ensures partner program compliance, manages certifications and audits, maintains partner tier requirements, and oversees accurate pipeline reporting and deal registration across multiple partner portals. You’ll work cross‑functionally with sales, marketing, delivery, and finance to help maintain top‑tier partner status and maximise incentives, funding, and joint business opportunities.


Key Responsibilities

Partner Program Compliance & Governance

  • Maintain partner tiers, competencies, certifications, and renewals across SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and GCP.
  • Manage audits, compliance requirements, user access, and certification tracking across partner portals (SAP for Me, ACE, MPC, PNH).
  • Support insurance, legal, and other compliance obligations.

SAP Program Support

  • Support PE Build, Sell, and Service track requirements and SAP Gold‑level compliance.
  • Manage global pipeline reporting, V2V/TI requirements, SAP‑sourced deal tracking, RISE Validated activities, CC Flex registrations, and development funding requests.

AWS Program Support

  • Support competencies (SAP Consulting, Migration & Modernization) and Premier Tier/Reseller/MSP requirements.
  • Manage ACE deal registration, reporting, funding submissions, and user/certification tracking.

Microsoft Program Support

  • Support ISD and SAP on Azure specialization.
  • Manage MPC deal registration, certification tracking, and funding submissions.

Google Cloud Program Support

  • Maintain Select Tier status, competencies, audits, deal registration, and funding submissions in PNH.

Analytics & Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Track partner performance metrics and compliance status.
  • Produce dashboards, reports, and insights for leadership and partner QBRs.
  • Support GTM plans and partner‑aligned offerings.

Relationship & Coordination Support

  • Assist Sales Leaders with partner relationship management.
  • Coordinate onboarding, documentation, internal enablement, and representing in partner reviews and audits.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or Technology (MBA preferred).
  • 3+ years’ experience in partner management, alliances, or cloud program operations.
  • Knowledge of SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and GCP ecosystems.
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and reporting skills.
  • Experience with partner portals and certification management.
  • SAP and cloud partner program experience strongly preferred.
  • Background check required in line with applicable law.

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

As a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. You will play a fundamental part in delivering a robust and scalable user experience, working in a supportive, team-oriented environment alongside other engineers and product stakeholders to bring new capabilities to life.

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, ensuring code is clean, performant, and adheres to high-quality standards;

  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, promoting best development practices and contributing to team growth.

Essential Skills

Highly Desirable Skills
